meta.source: PHANTOM PORTALS Design System — White / Crimson / Black (White-Forward Phantom Edition), supplied by the owner 2026-10-29; artwork direction from the owner's Trash Polka reference board.
meta.note: Names map 1:1 to the spec's dotted names (surface.canvas → surface-canvas). Tokens marked DERIVED fill gaps the spec implies (control borders, dark-panel text, states); every contrast figure was computed.

tokens.name: surface-canvas
tokens.usage: Main white-forward background (55–65% of any composition). Spec: surface.canvas.

tokens.name: surface-primary
tokens.usage: Cards, forms, command surfaces. Spec: surface.primary.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: DERIVED. Wells, tab-strip ground, table header rows, disabled fills. ink-secondary reads 6.38:1 on it.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Matte-black architecture: utility rail, terminals, HUD panels, secondary buttons. Spec: surface.inverse.

tokens.name: surface-inverse-raised
tokens.usage: DERIVED. Raised layer on black: terminal title bar, hovered rail item. White reads 14.3:1.

tokens.name: surface-crimson-soft
tokens.usage: Selected rows, active tab ground, annotations. ink-primary 15.5:1, accent-crimson 6.85:1 on it. Spec: surface.crimson-soft.

tokens.name: ink-primary
tokens.usage: Main typography and technical markings. 18.2:1 on white, 16.7:1 on canvas. Spec: ink.primary.

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Descriptions, metadata, labels. 7.66:1 on white, 7.03:1 on canvas. Spec: ink.secondary.

tokens.name: ink-on-inverse
tokens.usage: Text and icons on surface-inverse (18.2:1) and on crimson (8.05:1).

tokens.name: ink-on-inverse-secondary
tokens.usage: DERIVED. Secondary text on surface-inverse: 8.61:1.

tokens.name: accent-crimson
tokens.usage: Primary actions, active indicators, focus ring on light. 8.05:1 on white — safe for text and icons. Spec: accent.crimson.

tokens.name: accent-crimson-pressed
tokens.usage: DERIVED. Pressed state of crimson controls; white reads 10.7:1.

tokens.name: accent-hero
tokens.usage: Large crimson artwork and signature graphics (brush cuts, hero fields). White reads 6.55:1. Spec: accent.hero.

tokens.name: accent-electric
tokens.usage: Decorative lighting and animation only (laser lines, scan sweeps). Never text on light: 3.46:1 on white. Spec: accent.electric.

tokens.name: accent-crimson-on-inverse
tokens.usage: DERIVED. Active indicators and crimson text on surface-inverse — accent-crimson is only 2.26:1 there. 6.63:1.

tokens.name: border-default
tokens.usage: Subtle separation between surfaces (1.46:1 — never the only boundary of a control). Spec: border.default.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: DERIVED. Boundaries of inputs, toggles, ghost buttons: 3.77:1 on white, 3.46:1 on canvas (meets 3:1 for UI boundaries).

tokens.name: border-inverse
tokens.usage: DERIVED. Control boundaries on surface-inverse: 3.44:1.

tokens.name: status-success
tokens.usage: DERIVED. Verified / complete. Muted, not neon: 6.46:1 on white. Always with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: status-warning
tokens.usage: DERIVED. Caution, degraded, pending review: 6.33:1 on white. Always with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: status-error
tokens.usage: Errors and failed operations. Pair with the alert icon and a label.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on light surfaces: 2px solid, 2px offset.

tokens.name: focus-ring-inverse
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on surface-inverse: 2px solid white, 2px offset.

tokens.name: overlay-glass
tokens.usage: Glass overlays over artwork. Keep ≥ .85 alpha so text contrast holds; verify over the actual art.

tokens.name: overlay-scrim
tokens.usage: Modal scrim over the canvas.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero headline only (spec 48–64px). One per screen.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Prominent statistics; use tabular figures (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums).

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Diagnose, repair and recover machines from one offline toolkit.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Select a tool to inspect its sources and run history.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text in compact chips; hairline gaps.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Compact HUD internal spacing; gap between related controls.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Compact HUD padding; list row gap.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Panel padding (minimum); grid gutter.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Panel padding (comfortable); card gap.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Separation between major sections (minimum).

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: Separation between major sections (generous); hero padding.

tokens.name: space-64
tokens.usage: Hero and page-level breathing room.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Tactical frames, buttons, inputs, terminal and HUD panels — sharp or chamfered.

tokens.name: radius-8
tokens.usage: Cards, tool tiles, notifications (spec 8–12px).

tokens.name: radius-12
tokens.usage: Large surfaces: dialogs, AI response panel, hero card.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills, toggles, status dots, HUD rings.

tokens.name: depth-1
tokens.usage: Resting cards and tiles.

tokens.name: depth-2
tokens.usage: Hovered tiles, dropdowns, tooltips.

tokens.name: depth-3
tokens.usage: Dialogs, command palette, floating panels.

tokens.name: crimson-edge
tokens.usage: Active/selected signature edge with controlled bloom. One per view.

tokens.name: laser-glow
tokens.usage: Electric laser lines and scan sweeps only.

tokens.name: inset-well
tokens.usage: Input wells and sunken fields.

chamfer.note: Phantom Cut: diagonal corner cut on top-right and bottom-left, clip-path polygon(0 0, calc(100% - c) 0, 100% c, 100% 100%, c 100%, 0 calc(100% - c)). Apply to a ::before fill so focus rings are never clipped.

tokens.name: chamfer-6
tokens.usage: Small controls, badges.

tokens.name: chamfer-10
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, HUD frames.

tokens.name: chamfer-16
tokens.usage: Hero frames, terminal panels.

tokens.name: stroke-1
tokens.usage: Default borders, technical lines.

tokens.name: stroke-2
tokens.usage: Heavier framing of major surfaces, focus rings, active indicators.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Compact toolbar controls (pointer only; ≥24px target).

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default buttons and inputs (spec minimum 40px).

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Primary and touch actions (spec preferred 44px).

tokens.name: tabstrip-height
tokens.usage: Browser tab strip.

tokens.name: omnibox-height
tokens.usage: Omnibox / command field.

tokens.name: rail-width
tokens.usage: Left utility rail.

tokens.name: bookmarks-height
tokens.usage: Favorites bar.
